name: Tutorial Jr. Sentinel drop table

entries.name: Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece

item_resolution.note: MeowDB has two items named 'Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece' (347, icon key 4000000; 2584, icon key 4000067). 347 is the one MeowDB's own Tutorial Jr. Sentinel drop list uses (api_drops_q_monsterId_1.html) and the one quest 1005's itemRefs name (docs/canonical/quests.md, discrepancy 1); 2584 is needed by a Victoria Island quest.

notes: KuroDB flags the row 'Quest 1035'; under the C1 gate rule (D3-9) it is recorded as corroboration only: 347 is MeowDB subtype 'Monster Drop', so the entry is not quest-gated.

meowdb_reference.note: MeowDB's community-voted Classic drop list (with votes) and its read-only MSEA list, from the live page. Reference only: monster drop membership comes from Hidden Street (D3-6). item_id is MeowDB's own id for the name in its cached lists (null when the cache does not name it or no local item exists).

membership.version_note: Front page, 'Before Chaos', posted 21 June 2011: 'This site is archived directly from our GMS database ... with its Big Bang updates and changes.' It is post-Big-Bang GMS (v0.96 era), a different game version from MapleStory Classic World (MeowDB). Its stats differ from MeowDB's (Snail HP 15 here, 45 on MeowDB).

meowdb_reference.item_ids.note: MeowDB item ids for the reference lists, matched by name within MeowDB's own cached drop list

gaps: mesos: KuroDB's Tutorial Jr. Sentinel page (tools/kurodb/captures/9300018.json) has no "Meso drop" row, so the monster drops no mesos (D3-5); MeowDB has no meso report and Hidden Street says "Mesos: ?"
notes: Membership: Hidden Street's "Before Chaos" drop lists (https://bc.hidden-street.net/monster/tutorial-jr-sentinel, read 2026-10-05T08:09:54.751Z): post-Big-Bang GMS v0.96, a different game version from MapleStory Classic, used by the project owner's decision D3-6. Every member stays in entries; one without a KuroDB chance or a local item never rolls.

Chance: KuroDB (https://playkuro.com/database/#monsters/9300018, read 2026-10-05T07:46:08.420Z, "Updated 10/2/2026"), only for members its page also lists, joined by name through tools/sources/crosswalk/drop_items.json (D3-4). KuroDB "

% base" is the chance before any server-wide drop-rate multiplier; MisoStory applies none (multiplier 1).
excluded_kuro_only: KuroDB rows for this monster that no member matches. They never drop (KuroDB never adds a member, D3-6).

Runtime (contract C1): an entry rolls only when chance_state is resolved, item_id is not null and quest_gate is null or its quest is in progress. The meso bag rolls only when its amount and chance are both resolved; the amount is a uniform integer in [min, max].
